name: EXM_MOBILE_EXPENSE_MATCHES
description: This table contains expense items created from mobile devices and expense items created from corporate card transactions that are either automatically matched by the application or manually matched by users.

columns.name: CREDIT_CARD_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense item created from a corporate card transaction.

columns.name: MOBILE_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Expense item created from mobile device.

columns.name: MERGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the expense item created from a mobile device is already merged to an expense item created from a corporate card transaction.

columns.name: RECORD_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is a matching or a duplicate record. Possible values are MATCHING and DUPLICATE.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a group of duplicate expenses.

columns.name: ANCHOR_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the anchor expense within a group of duplicate expenses.

columns.name: ANCHOR_RANK
columns.description: Indicates the priority of anchors within a group of duplicate expenses.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person identifier of the expense owner.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment identifier of the expense owner.

columns.name: UX_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the expense is in Sequoia or Classic interface.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MATCH_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage by which an uploaded mobile expense item matches a corporate card transaction.

columns.name: MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by the matching algorithm that denotes the strength of the match between a digital assistant expense and a corporate card expense.
